'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]], [[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland Security Force|Puntland forces]] fight against [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIS]] in the IL-Ameira mountains, stopping seven [[Loitering munition|drones loaded with bombs]] and removing ten [[landmines]]. The forces also destroy five ISIS bases. They capture [[military bases]], including a [[water well]] in Jeceel Valley near [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains of [[Balidhidhin District]], [[Bari, Somalia|Bari]], [[Puntland]]. [https://horseedmedia.net/puntland-forces-gain-ground-in-offensive-against-isis-stronghold/398718/ (Horseed Media)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news/2025/Jan/wararka_maanta10-188970.htm?utm_source=hiiraan&utm_medium=WararkaMaantaFront (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches airstrikes on a power station and two ports in [[Houthi]]-controlled [[Yemen]] in retaliation for Houthi drone and missile attacks on [[Israel]], with pro-Houthi media reporting that at least three people were injured. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2025/01/10/security-firm-says-airstrikes-reported-in-houthi-controlled-yemen-including-oil-port (Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 California wildfires]]
**[[January 2025 Southern California wildfires]]
***Amid ongoing wildfires, authorities in [[Los Angeles County]], [[California]], [[United States]], impose a curfew and announce the deployment of the [[California National Guard]] in order to protect homes in evacuated areas from [[looting]]. [https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/california-wildfires/curfew-la-county-wildfires/3600157/ (KNBC-TV)]
***The [[United States Department of Health and Human Services]] issues a [[Public health emergency (United States)|public health emergency]] for California in response to injuries and [[mental health]] impacts caused by the ongoing wildfires. [https://www.cnn.com/weather/live-news/los-angeles-wildfires-palisades-eaton-california-01-10-25-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*Six people are killed and nine others are injured after an unspecified vehicle’s tire blew and overturned in [[Huíla Province]], [[Angola]]. [https://english.news.cn/20250112/28793ccf2c6344db88c77b6074c49a64/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Three of the twelve miners that were reported missing yesterday in an explosion at a coal mine in Singidi, [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]], are found dead by rescue workers. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/bodies-found-after-gas-explosion-causes-coal-mine-to-collapse-in-southwest-pakistan-1.7171084 (CTV News)]
*Three women are killed and five children are injured in a [[Crowd collapses and crushes#crowd "stampedes"|stampede]] at the [[Umayyad Mosque]] in [[Damascus]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/stampede-kills-three-women-injures-five-children-umayyad-mosque-damascus-2025-01-10/ (Reuters)]
*Three people on the ground are killed and three others are injured when a [[Cessna 172]] aircraft crashes into a road near [[Malindi]], [[Kenya]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kenya-plane-crash-malindi-3c41baec5aa126b1d25d93313566f14d (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 in climate change]]
**The [[Copernicus Climate Change Service]] confirms that 2024 was the warmest calendar year since records began in 1850, with the [[Global surface temperature|average global temperature]] reaching 1.6 °C above [[Pre-industrial society|pre-industrial]] levels, surpassing the 1.5 °C [[Climate change|warming]] benchmark set in 2016 by the [[Paris Agreement]] for the first time. [https://climate.copernicus.eu/global-climate-highlights-2024 (C3S)] [https://www.politico.eu/article/world-edge-breaching-paris-agreement-scientists-say-planet-heating-hottest-year-climate-change/ (Politico)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cd7575x8yq5o (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025 Moldovan energy crisis]]
**[[Moldova]]'s [[List of states with limited recognition|unrecognized breakaway region]] of [[Transnistria]] extends its [[state of emergency]] for another month due to an [[energy crisis]] following the suspension of [[Russia in the European energy sector|Russian gas supplies]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldovas-pro-russian-separatists-extend-state-emergency-amid-gas-cutoff-2025-01-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombia–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[government of Venezuela]] closes the [[Colombia–Venezuela border|border]] with [[Colombia]] ahead of the swearing-in of [[Nicolás Maduro]] for a third term as [[President of Venezuela]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/01/10/venezuela-closes-colombia-border-ahead-of-maduro-s-swearing-in_6736907_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[Denmark–United States relations]], [[Proposals for the United States to purchase Greenland]]
**The [[Prime Minister of Greenland]], [[Mute Bourup Egede]], says that his country "has a desire for independence" and he, in particular, is ready to speak with [[President of the United States|US President]]-elect [[Donald Trump]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/10/americas/greenland-trump-denmark-press-conference-intl-latam/index.html (Bloomberg)]
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States government]] imposes a new series of sanctions targeting [[Russia]]'s [[Energy in Russia|energy]] sector, including the [[Gazprom Neft]] and [[Surgutneftegas]] oil companies. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/10/politics/biden-admin-russia-energy-sanctions-ukraine/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Italy–Syria relations]]
**The [[Foreign Minister of Italy|Italian Foreign Minister]], [[Antonio Tajani]], meets in [[Damascus]] with [[Ahmed al-Sharaa]], de facto leader of [[Syria]]. [https://es.euronews.com/2025/01/10/tajani-se-reune-con-al-sharaa-en-damasco-italia-sera-el-puente-entre-la-nueva-siria-y-la-u (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Indictments against Donald Trump]]
**[[Prosecution of Donald Trump in New York]]
***[[President-elect of the United States|U.S. president-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] is sentenced for [[falsifying business records]], with judge [[Juan Merchan]] ordering an [[unconditional discharge]], stating that imprisonment or fines could cause Trump to eventually have his convictions overturned. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-hush-money-sentencing-stormy-daniels-33e070bd3c1acb609bba13f23d784a3a (AP)]
*[[Death and funeral of Alexei Navalny]]
**[[Russia]] financial watchdog [[Rosfinmonitoring]] rejects requests to remove former [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|opposition leader]] [[Alexei Navalny]] from their state sponsor of terrorism list despite his death a year ago. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-wont-cancel-navalnys-terrorist-status-even-though-hes-dead-widow-says-2025-01-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[International reactions to the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[Sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis]]
**[[U.S.]] authorities announce an increased $25 million reward for information leading to the arrest of [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4g9ezyw0keo (BBC News)]
*[[Vince McMahon sex trafficking scandal]]
**The [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] announces that former [[WWE]] CEO [[Vince McMahon]] has agreed to pay a $400,000 fine and reimburse $1.3 million to WWE as part of a settlement to drop [[accounting fraud]] charges. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/10/business/wwe-vince-mcmahon-sec-settlement/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**[[Third inauguration of Nicolás Maduro]]
***[[Nicolás Maduro]] is sworn in for a third six-year term as [[President of Venezuela]] in [[Caracas]]. The ceremony takes place under heavy security measures with the opposition boycotting and protesting the ceremony while continuing to insist that the legitimate president-elect is [[Edmundo González Urrutia]]. Many countries and international organizations also consider the [[2024 Venezuelan presidential election|election]] to be fraudulent. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/10/americas/venezuelas-nicolas-maduro-sworn-in-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2024 Austrian legislative election]]
**[[President of Austria|Austrian president]] [[Alexander Van der Bellen]] appoints [[Foreign Minister of Austria|foreign minister]] [[Alexander Schallenberg]] as acting [[Chancellor of Austria|chancellor]] to succeed [[Karl Nehammer]], who resigned six days ago. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/austrian-foreign-minister-schallenberg-takes-over-caretaker-chancellor-2025-01-10/ (Reuters)]
